1.title: Everyone starts equal
1.body: Each player begins with the same amount of cash, so the game is decided by choices, not a head start.

2.title: Roll and move
2.body: On your turn, roll the dice and travel around the board. A double earns you an extra roll.

3.title: Claim properties
3.body: Land on an unowned property and buy it. From then on, anyone who stops there pays you rent.

4.title: Build to raise the stakes
4.body: Own every property in a color group to unlock houses and hotels, and watch the rent climb.

5.title: Outlast the table
5.body: Trade, bargain and manage your cash. A player who cannot pay is out, and the last one standing wins.

footer.disclaimer: Deal Rush is an independent game, not affiliated with any other board game brand.

meta.title: Deal Rush: a free online property-trading board game
meta.description: Buy, bargain, build and outlast your friends. Play Deal Rush free in your browser, no signup needed.

landing.howIntro: Five simple ideas are all you need to get started.

features.title: Built for a proper table
features.intro: Everything a good game night needs, without the setup.

1.title: Real-time rooms
1.body: Everyone sees every move the instant it happens.

2.title: Your rules
2.body: Set starting cash, jail rules, auctions and turn timers for each room.

3.title: Bots fill the table
3.body: Short a player? A bot takes the empty seat so the game never waits.

4.title: Fair by design
4.body: The server rolls every die and checks every move, so nobody can cheat.

5.title: Play anywhere
5.body: Runs in your browser on desktop and mobile. Nothing to install.

6.title: Trade and bargain
6.body: Offer swaps, negotiate with rivals and strike deals mid-game.

board.title: A board with its own character
board.body: Forty tiles, eight color sets, surprise cards, and a jail you'll want to avoid.

friends.title: A room for your friends in seconds
friends.intro: No signup, no downloads. Just a link.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.intro: Quick answers to the things people ask first.

1.a: No. Pick a nickname and play.

2.a: From 2 to 8 players, and bots can fill any empty seat.

3.a: Yes, Deal Rush is free to play.

4.q: How do I play with friends?
4.a: Create a private room and share its link or code.

5.q: What if I lose my connection?
5.a: Reopen the page and rejoin the room to continue where you left off.

6.q: Is it affiliated with other board games?
6.a: No. Deal Rush is an independent game with its own board and identity.
